name: CoinGecko API
rate_limits: Demo (free): 30 requests/minute, 10,000 requests/month. Public (no key): 5-15 requests/minute.
notes: Most comprehensive free crypto API. Covers 10,000+ coins, 600+ exchanges. Up to 12 years of historical data with 5-minute granularity. Free Demo plan requires signup but no payment. Auth via x-cg-demo-api-key header or query param. Excellent for AI crypto analysis due to depth and breadth of data.
